title: Siemens Energy’s full Supervisory and Executive Boards meet in Saudi Arabia
summary: Underscoring the Kingdom’s strategic importance to Siemens Energy

contentHtml:
Siemens Energy’s full Supervisory Board and Executive Board meets at the Dammam Hub. Image Courtesy: Siemens Energy

Underscoring the Kingdom’s strategic importance to Siemens Energy

Press Release

Joe Kaeser, Chairman of the Siemens Energy Supervisory Board, and Dr. Christian Bruch, President and CEO of Siemens Energy, with Siemens Energy’s full Supervisory Board and Executive Board at the Dammam Hub on September 30, 2026. The gathering marks the first time the entire Board has met in Saudi Arabia, underscoring the Kingdom’s strategic importance to Siemens Energy. 

For more than a decade, the Dammam Hub, Siemens Energy’s largest facility in the Middle East, has advanced localization by building capabilities across gas turbines, compressors, grid technologies, manufacturing and service. The Hub brings critical energy technology closer to customers while developing Saudi talent, strengthening system reliability and supporting the Kingdom’s growing energy infrastructure.
